Loss report: forgejo -> drone
[lost] pipeline/ci display.name (the Drone pipeline name is its id; the display name is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build job.runner (only the platform has a Drone form; other runner labels are lost)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.shell (Drone compiles commands into its own set -e script that runs under /bin/sh; a step with no shell from a GHA or GitLab source runs under bash there, so bash-only syntax fails when the image sh is dash)
[external] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 script.interpolation: secret for variable (variable REGION is bound to the secret REGION; Drone has no variables, so create the secret REGION with the value of the variable)
[emulated] pipeline/ci pipeline.env: copied into the environment of every pipeline document (a step variable of the same name wins)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build job.env: environment of every step (a document environment holds strings only, so a secret variable is set on each step)
